title: fix(app-shell): relay a list view's own fieldOrder to ListView (objectui#7516)
body:
Fixes #7516
Clause-②: yes — the relay begins accepting a declared spelling it drops today (the ruling's own reading).

Executes ruling 5635656263, ratified 5809517921: add the per-view `fieldOrder` rung to `renderListView`'s relay in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, pin it at the relay, flip the census ledger entry from `known-gap` to the rung's evidence, one `patch` changeset.

## What changed

- **The rung.** `fieldOrder: viewDef.fieldOrder ?? listSchema.fieldOrder`, placed beside the `hiddenFields` rung and resolved by the same precedence: the active view's value wins; a view that authors none keeps the list node's own (`...listSchema`). The value lands in the same `schema.fieldOrder` slot the list-node spelling fills, so `ListView`'s `effectiveFields` memo composes the two spellings identically by construction.
- **The pin** (`ObjectView.fieldOrderRelay-7516.test.tsx`, beside the `rowColor` / `description` relay pins; `ListView` stubbed, its `schema` prop captured): three FIX cases (a per-view `fieldOrder` arrives verbatim; it overrides a list-node `fieldOrder`; it resolves by the same precedence as `hiddenFields` in one render) and two CONTROLs (the list node's own `fieldOrder` is unchanged when the view authors none; none anywhere stays absent).
- **The census** (`ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts`): the `fieldOrder` `known-gap` row is removed, and the rung is recorded the way the census records its other live rungs — a named check, `objectui#7516 — the per-view fieldOrder rung is present`, beside the `description` (#7199) and `rowColor` (#7218) ones. The two stale header sentences ("still open", "carries `needs-user-decision`") are rewritten. The census CONTROL case that used `fieldOrder` as its example of a declared absence now uses `operations` (a reader-having `node-authored` absence), since `fieldOrder` is no longer one.
- **The relay's header comment** now says all three instances of the class carry their rung.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/7516-fieldorder-relay-rung.md`, `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

## Premises, measured on `origin/main` a7df45ff1 before the first edit

- **H1 (no rung) holds.** The `fullSchema` literal wrote `hiddenFields` from `viewDef` and nothing for `fieldOrder`. Reproduced by the new pin on the base relay: `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`; the per-view case read `expected undefined to deeply equal [ 'stage', 'name' ]`, the override cases read the list node's `[ 'owner', 'stage', 'name' ]`. Why the spread carries nothing on this route: `plugin-view`'s composition fills `fieldOrder` from a NAMED list view only (`currentNamedViewConfig?.fieldOrder`), and this page hands it `views`, not `listViews`.
- **H2 (composition) — no disagreement, so no stop.** Spec `origin/main` (objectstack a08e059) `ListViewSchema` describe text: `hiddenFields` removes names from the `columns` projection "before `fieldOrder` orders the remainder"; `fieldOrder` "sorts what survives `columns` minus `hiddenFields` and never adds a field. A surviving column absent from `fieldOrder` sorts LAST, after every listed one, keeping its `columns`-relative order; a name listed here that did not survive orders nothing." `ListView`'s `effectiveFields` memo: starts from `schema.columns`, drops FLS-denied columns (the extra step the spec's own docblock names), drops `hiddenFields`, then sorts by an index map built from `schema.fieldOrder` with unlisted entries at `Infinity` (two unlisted compare as NaN, which the sort treats as equal, so the stable sort keeps their `columns` order). Same three steps, same order, same unlisted-last rule. **Which spelling wins when both carry `fieldOrder`: the view's**, matching the `hiddenFields` rung.
- **H3 (census)** — done as described above; ablation below.
- **H4 (pin)** — red on base, green on head, figures above and below.
- **H5 (the relay's header comment)** — measured: it listed objectui#7516 among the three shipped instances but did not literally call it open. Edited to say all three now carry their rung, which is true after this change.

## Verification — all runs on HEAD `09d496810`

- **Pin + census, head:** `Test Files 2 passed (2)` · `Tests 30 passed (30)`.
- **Ablation (rung deleted, one-shot, no file left behind):** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) with anchor `fieldOrder: viewDef.fieldOrder ?? listSchema.fieldOrder,` → `anchor x1 → x0`, `blob 51a823a8ab22 → d16c4a7d6716`, a `grep -c` inside the run read `0`. Predicted before the run: census 2 red, pin 3 red, controls green, `5 failed / 25 passed`. Measured: `Tests 5 failed | 25 passed (30)` — census `leaves NO member both unrelayed and undeclared` (received `[ "fieldOrder" ]`) and `objectui#7516 — the per-view fieldOrder rung is present`; pin: the three FIX cases. Restore: `blob after restore == blob at HEAD (51a823a8ab22)`, `git diff HEAD empty`. No build is involved: both files read `./ObjectView` from source (the census from disk text, the pin through a relative import).
- **Dependency closure:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` → `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` type-check** (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `--listFiles` on the test project lists both `ObjectView.fieldOrderRelay-7516.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts`.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` tests, the whole package (799 test files), run from the repo root in chunks under the shared verify lock:** every chunk `command-exit 0`, zero failures; two pre-existing environment-conditional skips (`describe.runIf(DRIVEN)` in the audit-history date-zone test, `skipIf` in the flow-node spec-reconciliation test). The chunks also covered 46 tests in other packages and `apps/console` that read `app-shell` sources from disk.
- **Gates (lock-free, verdict lines):** `check-changeset-presence` ✅ `3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)` · `check:new-line-citations` `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)` · `check:control-bytes` ✅ OK · `check-changeset-no-major` ✅ · `check-changeset-overwrite` ✅ · `check-changeset-fixed` ✅ · `check-pending-changeset-literals` ✅ · `check-vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape` ✅ OK · `check-test-path-roots` ✅ OK · `check-shell-escape-residue` ✅ · `check-action-ref-convention` ✅ · `check-type-check-coverage` ✅ · `check-lint-coverage` ✅ · `check:unreferenced-sources` / `handler-key-reads` / `metadata-write-doors` / `doc-example-readers` / `self-import` / `phantom-deps` OK · `check:comment-mask-corpus` within the residue objectui#7882 holds (the one disagreeing file is `apps/console/src/pages/DocsIndex.tsx`, untouched here) · `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the four paths: `NOT GOVERNED`. `check-changeset-claims` (report-only) names `.changeset/7070-no-invented-gantt-date-fields.md` for mentioning `ObjectView.tsx`; that paragraph is about the gantt branch, which this change does not touch — re-read, still true.
- **Lint, narrowed and proven:** (1) population from ESLint's own config — `isPathIgnored` is false for all three changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files; (2) `eslint --format json` over them: 3 files, 0 errors (warnings: `ObjectView.tsx` 171 on head and 171 on base; the new pin 6 `no-explicit-any` warnings, the same shape as its `rowColor` sibling; the census 0); (3) invariance — `calculateConfigForFile` reports no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` (the config extends the non-type-checked `tseslint.configs.recommended`), and no custom rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Not run locally, CI's: `performance-budget` (needs a full console build; the change is one object-literal property), `readme-exports` / `spec-range-floors` / `published-dist` (not reached: no manifest, export or docs change), E2E.

## Acceptance notes

- `known-gap` now has no entry in the ledger. Its kind and its evidence check stay in the census as the machinery for the next gap; the check iterates nothing today.
- `plugin-view`'s own composition reads `fieldOrder` from the named list view only, while it reads `hiddenFields` from `activeView` (the `views` entry). Not a defect this card carries: the only in-tree hosts passing `renderListView` are this page, whose rung now covers the `views` entry, and the Studio design surface, which has no saved views. Noted, not filed.
